name: writing
description: Writing and content skills: github-readme (README structure, onboarding flow, examples, contribution guidance), humanizer (strip signs of AI-generated writing, based on Wikipedia's guide), and readability (clarity and scannability for web content, docs, and long-form text) — adapted from Nate Berkopec's dotfiles — plus voice-profile (match a person's writing voice from a profile of their own rules). Ships a readme-reminder hook that audits READMEs with the github-readme checker, a voice-intent-reminder hook that nudges applying a discovered voice profile before writing, and a voice-reminder hook that scans prose (incl. HTML webcopy) against that profile on write.
